shorts_extract.hook: You can picture their face, their job, and even the first letter — so why does their name freeze solid on the tip of your tongue?
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Deborah Burke's 1991 4-week word-block diary study (3.92 vs 5.4 vs 6.56 blocks) + Warriner & Humphreys' 2008 10s-vs-30s straining trap.
shorts_extract.twist: Why refusing to Google a stuck name trains your brain to freeze again 48 hours later — and why looking it up in 10 seconds fixes the wire.
